subject: Request: add CloudLogix as subprocessor — MSA redlines & DPA coordination
messages:
From: Daniel Ruiz <daniel.ruiz@acmecloud.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AcmeCloud Legal <legal@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: add CloudLogix as subprocessor — logging vendor

Hi Kimberly,

Quick one — we want to onboard CloudLogix as a subprocessor for our logging pipeline (ingest and short-term retention for telemetry). Attached is a one-row CSV with the proposed scope and contact (vendor_subprocessor_list.csv).

Key asks from our side:
- Can Redwood accept CloudLogix as a subprocessor under the current MSA + DPA?
- If not, what redlines (MSA or Order Form) do you need so we can keep the rollout on schedule?
- What evidence (SOC 2, encryption at rest, access controls) do you require and where should we upload it?

Target go-live: Jan 15, 2027. This is non-production telemetry only — no unredacted PII should be stored longer than 30 days.

I attached the CSV and a brief network diagram (inline link in the CSV). Happy to jump on a call; we're hoping to avoid a contract amendment if a DPA addendum and SOC report suffice.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Ruiz
Senior Vendor Manager — AcmeCloud
daniel.ruiz@acmecloud.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: vendor_subprocessor_list.csv

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Ruiz <daniel.ruiz@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: add CloudLogix as subprocessor — logging vendor

Thanks Daniel — looping in Dev and Marissa to scope the review.

Quick clarifying questions so we can triage this internally:
- Exact data categories: are logs filtered of PII before leaving your environment? If not, which fields may contain user identifiers?
- Retention: you mentioned 30 days — is that configurable per-customer?
- Access model: will CloudLogix have direct access to raw logs or will they only pull aggregated telemetry?
- Encryption: confirm whether logs are encrypted at rest and in transit, and whether keys are customer-managed.

Internally we'll do:
1) Legal (Marissa) will confirm whether we need an MSA annex vs. DPA addendum.
2) Security (Dev) will list the minimum evidence: SOC 2 Type II, summary of pentest, subprocessor agreement with CloudLogix.
3) Sales/Finance check on whether any commercial changes (Order Form) are required.

I've attached a working redline snapshot (redline_MSA_v3.docx) with suggested bullets to capture subprocessing limits (retention caps, permitted use, audit rights). Please review and return the DPA questionnaire if you can.

Proposed internal timeline: 7 business days for legal/security review, then to you for comment; aim to close by Dec 17 to keep the Jan 15 target. If any evidence is missing we'll escalate sooner.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: redline_MSA_v3.docx

From: Daniel Ruiz <daniel.ruiz@acmecloud.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AcmeCloud Legal <legal@acmecloud.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: add CloudLogix as subprocessor — logging vendor

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the quick reply and the redline snapshot. Answers below and attached: dpa_questionnaire.pdf (completed) and an updated vendor_subprocessor_list.csv with contact for CloudLogix security.

- PII: CloudLogix receives logs that contain hashed user ids; we do not send raw SSNs or payment card numbers. Application-level identifiers are hashed prior to export.
- Retention: yes, CloudLogix can enforce a 30-day retention policy per-customer.
- Access: CloudLogix will have a dedicated ingest pipeline; they do not query customer production databases — access is to the logging stream only.
- Encryption: TLS in transit; AES-256 at rest. Keys are AcmeCloud-managed (not customer KMS).

We can provide SOC 2 Type II report and a pen test executive summary — both attached or available via a secure share (let me know which you prefer).

If your legal team prefers a DPA addendum + signed subprocessor appendix, we can route via DocuSign. No commercial change expected.

Regards,
Daniel

Attachments: dpa_questionnaire.pdf, vendor_subprocessor_list.csv

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 10:44:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: add CloudLogix as subprocessor — logging vendor

Marissa — forwarding AcmeCloud's request and their answers (below). Key points for legal:
- Scope limited to logging/telemetry; retention capped at 30 days.
- They confirm SOC 2 Type II and pen test summary available.
- CloudLogix keys are vendor-managed (Acme-managed), not customer KMS.

Questions for you:
1) Do we require an MSA annex or will a DPA addendum + subprocessor appendix suffice?
2) Are the redlines I sent (retention cap, permitted use, audit rights, notification timeline for changes) adequate, or should we push for additional controls (e.g., customer KMS, stricter access logging)?
3) If DPA addendum is OK, can you provide the template and confirm whether Sales needs to sign an updated Order Form?

I've highlighted the sections in the attached redline_MSA_v3.docx for quick review and included the completed DPA questionnaire from Acme. If you want a short call with Acme's vendor manager (Daniel) and CloudLogix security, I can schedule 30 minutes this week.

Thanks,
Kimberly

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 15:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: add CloudLogix as subprocessor — logging vendor (next steps & approvals)

Thanks for the context and for flagging the vendor materials. Reviewed the redline snapshot and the completed DPA questionnaire — overall acceptable but a few mandatory items before we proceed:

Action items (legal + security):
- Require an executed DPA addendum signed by AcmeCloud and CloudLogix (use DocuSign link provided). Template attached: dpa_addendum_template.docx.
- Obtain SOC 2 Type II report and a redacted penetration test executive summary (we need scope & date).
- Add explicit contractual language that logs containing hashed identifiers are still treated as "personal data" for the purposes of audit and breach notifications.
- Limit retention to 30 days in the DPA; include a technical control clause that retention is enforceable and auditable.
- Access controls: require least-privilege access, MFA for all admin accounts, and a list of privileged users with contact info.
- Encryption KMS: vendor-managed keys are OK only if we have a documented key management policy; prefer customer KMS for any production PII (but for telemetry we can accept vendor-managed keys).

Commercial / implementation notes:
- No Order Form amendment required if commercial terms unchanged — Sales just needs to confirm.
- If CloudLogix will process telemetry for multiple Acme products, we should include a subprocessor appendix enumerating systems in scope.

Timeline: please collect the SOC2 and pentest summary by EOD Dec 10. Legal will draft the DPA addendum this week; once we have the evidence, we will route for signing (DocuSign). If any of the evidence is not available by Dec 10, we will require a compensating control and a 1:1 call with CloudLogix security.

I can coordinate the DPA drafting. Kimberly, please confirm whether you want us to request customer-managed KMS for any specific customers or keep the telemetry scope to vendor-managed keys.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: dpa_addendum_template.docx
